record.bible_text: Now Joab<WH03097> the son<WH01121> of Zeruiah<WH06870> perceived<WH03045><WTH8799> that the king's<WH04428> heart<WH03820> <FI>was<Fi> toward Absalom<WH053>.

And Joab<WH03097> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to Tekoah<WH08620>, and fetched<WH03947><WTH8799> thence a wise<WH02450> woman<WH0802>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner<WH056><WTH8693>, and put on<WH03847><WTH8798> now mourning<WH060> apparel<WH0899>, and anoint<WH05480><WTH8799> not thyself with oil<WH08081>, but be as a woman<WH0802> that had a long<WH07227> time<WH03117> mourned<WH056><WTH8690> for the dead<WH04191><WTH8801>:
And come<WH0935><WTH8804> to the king<WH04428>, and speak<WH01696><WTH8765> on this manner<WH01697> unto him. So Joab<WH03097> put<WH07760><WTH8799> the words<WH01697> in her mouth<WH06310>.

And when the woman<WH0802> of Tekoah<WH08621> spake<WH0559><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428>, she fell<WH05307><WTH8799> on her face<WH0639> to the ground<WH0776>, and did obeisance<WH07812><WTH8691>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Help<WH03467><WTH8685>, O king<WH04428>. <RF>Help: Heb. Save<Rf>

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered<WH0559><WTH8799>, I <FI>am<Fi> indeed<WH061> a widow<WH0490> woman<WH0802>, and mine husband<WH0376> is dead<WH04191><WTH8799>.

And thy handmaid<WH08198> had two<WH08147> sons<WH01121>, and they two<WH08147> strove together<WH05327><WTH8735> in the field<WH07704>, and <FI>there was<Fi> none to part<WH05337><WTH8688> them, but the one<WH0259> smote<WH05221><WTH8686> the other<WH0259>, and slew<WH04191><WTH8686> him. <RF>none...: Heb. no deliverer between them<Rf>

And, behold, the whole family<WH04940> is risen<WH06965><WTH8804> against thine handmaid<WH08198>, and they said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Deliver<WH05414><WTH8798> him that smote<WH05221><WTH8688> his brother<WH0251>, that we may kill<WH04191><WTH8686> him, for the life<WH05315> of his brother<WH0251> whom he slew<WH02026><WTH8804>; and we will destroy<WH08045><WTH8686> the heir<WH03423><WTH8802> also: and so they shall quench<WH03518><WTH8765> my coal<WH01513> which is left<WH07760><WTH8800>, and shall not leave<WH07604><WTH8738> to my husband<WH0376> <FI>neither<Fi> name<WH08034> nor remainder<WH07611> upon<WH06440> the earth<WH0127>. <RF>upon...: Heb. upon the face of the earth<Rf>
And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the woman<WH0802>, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> to thine house<WH01004>, and I will give charge<WH06680><WTH8762> concerning thee.

And the woman<WH0802> of Tekoah<WH08621> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the king<WH04428>, My lord<WH0113>, O king<WH04428>, the iniquity<WH05771> <FI>be<Fi> on me, and on my father's<WH01> house<WH01004>: and the king<WH04428> and his throne<WH03678> <FI>be<Fi> guiltless<WH05355>.

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Whosoever saith<WH01696><WTH8764> <FI>ought<Fi> unto thee, bring<WH0935><WTH8689> him to me, and he shall not touch<WH05060><WTH8800> thee any more<WH03254><WTH8686>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> she, I pray thee, let the king<WH04428> remember<WH02142><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers<WH01350><WTH8802> of blood<WH01818> to destroy<WH07843><WTH8763> any more<WH07235><WTH8687>, lest they destroy<WH08045><WTH8686> my son<WH01121>. And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>As<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, there shall not one hair<WH08185> of thy son<WH01121> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> to the earth<WH0776>. <RF>that...: Heb. that the revenger of blood do not multiply to destroy<Rf>

Then the woman<WH0802> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Let thine handmaid<WH08198>, I pray thee, speak<WH01696><WTH8762> <FI>one<Fi> word<WH01697> unto my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>. And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Say on<WH01696><WTH8761>.

And the woman<WH0802> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Wherefore then hast thou thought<WH02803><WTH8804> such a thing against the people<WH05971> of God<WH0430>? for the king<WH04428> doth speak<WH01696><WTH8693> this thing<WH01697> as one which is faulty<WH0818>, in that the king<WH04428> doth not fetch home again<WH07725><WTH8687> his banished<WH05080><WTH8737>.

For we must needs<WH04191><WTH8800> die<WH04191><WTH8799>, and <FI>are<Fi> as water<WH04325> spilt<WH05064><WTH8737> on the ground<WH0776>, which cannot be gathered up again<WH0622><WTH8735>; neither doth God<WH0430> respect<WH05375><WTH8799> <FI>any<Fi>  person<WH05315>: yet doth he devise<WH02803><WTH8804> means<WH04284>, that his banished<WH05080><WTH8737> be not expelled<WH05080><WTH8799> from him. <RF>neither...: or, because God hath not taken away his life, he hath also devised means, etc<Rf>

Now therefore that I am come<WH0935><WTH8804> to speak<WH01696><WTH8763> of this thing<WH01697> unto my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>, <FI>it is<Fi> because the people<WH05971> have made me afraid<WH03372><WTH8765>: and thy handmaid<WH08198> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I will now speak<WH01696><WTH8762> unto the king<WH04428>; it may be that the king<WH04428> will perform<WH06213><WTH8799> the request<WH01697> of his handmaid<WH0519>.

For the king<WH04428> will hear<WH08085><WTH8799>, to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> his handmaid<WH0519> out of the hand<WH03709> of the man<WH0376> <FI>that would<Fi> destroy<WH08045><WTH8687> me and my son<WH01121> together<WH03162> out of the inheritance<WH05159> of God<WH0430>.

Then thine handmaid<WH08198> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The word<WH01697> of my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428> shall now be comfortable<WH04496>: for as an angel<WH04397> of God<WH0430>, so <FI>is<Fi> my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428> to discern<WH08085><WTH8800> good<WH02896> and bad<WH07451>: therefore the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> will be with thee. <RF>comfortable: Heb. for rest<Rf> <RF>to discern: Heb. to hear<Rf>

Then the king<WH04428> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the woman<WH0802>, Hide<WH03582><WTH8762> not from me, I pray thee, the thing<WH01697> that I shall ask<WH07592><WTH8802> thee. And the woman<WH0802> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Let my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428> now speak<WH01696><WTH8762>.

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Is not<Fi> the hand<WH03027> of Joab<WH03097> with thee in all this? And the woman<WH0802> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>As<Fi>  thy soul<WH05315> liveth<WH02416>, my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>, none<WH0376> can<WH0786> turn to the right hand<WH03231><WTH8687> or to the left<WH08041><WTH8687> from ought that my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>: for thy servant<WH05650> Joab<WH03097>, he bade<WH06680><WTH8765> me, and he put<WH07760><WTH8804> all these words<WH01697> in the mouth<WH06310> of thine handmaid<WH08198>:

To<WH05668> fetch about<WH05437><WTH8763> this form<WH06440> of speech<WH01697> hath thy servant<WH05650> Joab<WH03097> done<WH06213><WTH8804> this thing<WH01697>: and my lord<WH0113> <FI>is<Fi> wise<WH02450>, according to the wisdom<WH02451> of an angel<WH04397> of God<WH0430>, to know<WH03045><WTH8800> all <FI>things<Fi> that <FI>are<Fi> in the earth<WH0776>.<CM>

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Joab<WH03097>, Behold now, I have done<WH06213><WTH8804> this thing<WH01697>: go<WH03212><WTH8798> therefore, bring<WH07725><WH00> the young man<WH05288> Absalom<WH053> again<WH07725><WTH8685>.

And Joab<WH03097> fell<WH05307><WTH8799> to the ground<WH0776> on his face<WH06440>, and bowed<WH07812><WTH8691> himself, and thanked<WH01288><WTH8762> the king<WH04428>: and Joab<WH03097> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, To day<WH03117> thy servant<WH05650> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> that I have found<WH04672><WTH8804> grace<WH02580> in thy sight<WH05869>, my lord<WH0113>, O king<WH04428>, in that the king<WH04428> hath fulfilled<WH06213><WTH8804> the request<WH01697> of his servant<WH05650>. <RF>thanked: Heb. blessed<Rf> <RF>his servant: or, thy servant<Rf>
So Joab<WH03097> arose<WH06965><WTH8799> and went<WH03212><WTH8799> to Geshur<WH01650>, and brought<WH0935><WTH8686> Absalom<WH053> to Jerusalem<WH03389>.

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Let him turn<WH05437><WTH8735> to his own house<WH01004>, and let him not see<WH07200><WTH8799> my face<WH06440>. So Absalom<WH053> returned<WH05437><WTH8735> to his own house<WH01004>, and saw<WH07200><WTH8804> not the king's<WH04428> face<WH06440>.

But in all Israel<WH03478> there was none<WH0376> to be so much<WH03966> praised<WH01984><WTH8763> as Absalom<WH053> for his beauty<WH03303>: from the sole<WH03709> of his foot<WH07272> even to the crown of his head<WH06936> there was no blemish<WH03971> in him. <RF>But...: Heb. And as Absalom there was not a beautiful man in all Israel to praise greatly<Rf>

And when he polled<WH01548><WTH8763> his head<WH07218>, (for it was at every year's<WH03117><WH03117> end<WH07093> that he polled<WH01548><WTH8762> <FI>it<Fi> : because <FI>the hair<Fi> was heavy<WH03513><WTH8804> on him, therefore he polled<WH01548><WTH8765> it:) he weighed<WH08254><WTH8804> the hair<WH08181> of his head<WH07218> at two hundred<WH03967> shekels<WH08255> after the king's<WH04428> weight<WH068>.

And unto Absalom<WH053> there were born<WH03205><WTH8735> three<WH07969> sons<WH01121>, and one<WH0259> daughter<WH01323>, whose name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Tamar<WH08559>: she was a woman<WH0802> of a fair<WH03303> countenance<WH04758>.<CM>
So Absalom<WH053> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> two full<WH03117> years<WH08141> in Jerusalem<WH03389>, and saw<WH07200><WTH8804> not the king's<WH04428> face<WH06440>.

Therefore Absalom<WH053> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> for Joab<WH03097>, to have sent<WH07971><WTH8800> him to the king<WH04428>; but he would<WH014><WTH8804> not come<WH0935><WTH8800> to him: and when he sent again<WH07971><WTH8799> the second time<WH08145>, he would<WH014><WTH8804> not come<WH0935><WTH8800>.

Therefore he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto his servants<WH05650>, See<WH07200><WTH8798>, Joab's<WH03097> field<WH02513> is near<WH0413> mine<WH03027>, and he hath barley<WH08184> there; go<WH03212><WTH8798> and set<WH03341><WTH8685> it on fire<WH0784>. And Absalom's<WH053> servants<WH05650> set<WH03341><WTH8686> the field<WH02513> on fire<WH0784>. <RF>near...: Heb. near my place<Rf>

Then Joab<WH03097> arose<WH06965><WTH8799>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Absalom<WH053> unto <FI>his<Fi> house<WH01004>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Wherefore have thy servants<WH05650> set<WH03341><WTH8689> my field<WH02513> on fire<WH0784>?

And Absalom<WH053> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> Joab<WH03097>, Behold, I sent<WH07971><WTH8804> unto thee, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Come<WH0935><WTH8798> hither, that I may send<WH07971><WTH8799> thee to the king<WH04428>, to say<WH0559><WTH8800>, Wherefore am I come<WH0935><WTH8804> from Geshur<WH01650>? <FI>it had been<Fi> good<WH02896> for me <FI>to have been<Fi> there still: now therefore let me see<WH07200><WTH8799> the king's<WH04428> face<WH06440>; and if there be<WH03426> <FI>any<Fi> iniquity<WH05771> in me, let him kill<WH04191><WTH8689> me.

So Joab<WH03097> came<WH0935><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428>, and told<WH05046><WTH8686> him: and when he had called<WH07121><WTH8799> for Absalom<WH053>, he came<WH0935><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428>, and bowed<WH07812><WTH8691> himself on his face<WH0639> to the ground<WH0776> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428>: and the king<WH04428> kissed<WH05401><WTH8799> Absalom<WH053>.<CM>
